newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Telkom to introduce new tariffs in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Telkom to introduce new tariffs in 1997.

text.p: Indonesian telecommunications giant PT Telkom said on Friday it planned to introduce new tariffs in January 1997 pending final government approval.

"We expect to have a new tariff schedule by the third week of December and apply the new tariffs from January 1997. I cannot tell you the details now, but the tariffs are likely to increase," said a company investor relations officer, who asked not be named.
He said that Telkom had recently submitted to the government a new formula for tariff adjustment and was awaiting final approval before it would apply the new rates.
"Based on final formula from the government, we can introduce a new tariff structure for the monthly, local and inter-local fees," he said.
He declined to give further details.
Telkom's share price rose 275 rupiah to 4,200 rupiah on a volume of 5.2 million shares at the end of morning session on Friday.
